title: S&P 500/400 constituents (market_data/weekly/{date}/constituents.json, v1)
description: Producer: collectors/constituents.py::collect. SSGA SPDR (SPY/MDY) membership + Wikipedia GICS sector/sub-industry. No embedded schema_version today (config#6946 era); this file is v1 of the external contract, versioned by filename/git history per architecture.d/146 rule 3 rather than a payload field -- a future payload schema_version is an additive, backward-compatible change. Consumer: crucible/data/universe.py (v2 declared universe), crucible-executor. Plan §3 boundary table row 4.

index_overlap.description: Names held by BOTH SPY and MDY on this date (a rebalance in flight), so present in both sp500_tickers and sp400_tickers and once in tickers. Omitted when empty. alpha-engine-config-I11470.

sector_fallback.description: Constituents whose sector_map/sector_etf_map entry came from the yfinance fallback rather than Wikipedia's GICS table (alpha-engine-config-I11468): `sector` is the GICS sector written to sector_map, `yf_sector`/`yf_industry` the raw yfinance evidence it was mapped from. Wikipedia lags brand-new index additions, so this is usually empty or a handful of names. Every ticker in `tickers` has a sector_map entry; the producer raises rather than publish one without. Absent on snapshots written before I11468.

fetched_at.description: Wall-clock stamp of the fetch, not a data value (alpha-engine-config-I10894): shadow/parity.py excludes it from `values.breaches` and reports it under `provenance_diffs`, because a shadow run and its live counterpart never fetch at the same instant.

weight_map.description: Per-constituent index weight as FRACTIONS normalised to sum 1.0 WITHIN each index (alpha-engine-config-I11295), from the Weight column of the SSGA holdings file. Cross-index normalisation would make a ticker's weight depend on the other fund's roster, which is not what 'weight in the S&P 500' means -- so `index_of` names the index a value is relative to and must be read alongside it. ABSENT OR EMPTY MEANS UNKNOWN, NEVER ZERO: a cache-served run carries weight_method='cache_no_weights' and no weights, because a weight is only meaningful as of a date and a stale one is undetectable downstream.

index_of.description: The index each weighted ticker belongs to, so a consumer can renormalise or filter to one index without re-deriving membership from counts -- the ordering-contract failure mode of alpha-engine-config-I6946.

weight_method.description: Weight provenance a consumer must honour rather than infer: 'ssga_holdings_file' when weights came from the live file, 'cache_no_weights' when the local cache was served and carries none.

weight_sum_raw_sp500.description: The S&P 500 equity roster's PRE-normalisation weight sum, in the source file's own units. The only place a units flip or an equity-filter change stays visible: normalisation would otherwise absorb it and every weight would still sum to 1.0 while being wrong. Null when that index was not fetched.

weight_sum_raw_sp400.description: The S&P 400 equity roster's PRE-normalisation weight sum, in the source file's own units. The only place a units flip or an equity-filter change stays visible: normalisation would otherwise absorb it and every weight would still sum to 1.0 while being wrong. Null when that index was not fetched.
